title: DBinventory
text: One call whole run: arguments: export_dir writes one CSV per store table (export_format = "parquet" Parquet), include, exclude schema narrow run part database. inventory_run() accepts anything db_connect() : DBI connection, ODBC connection string DSN name, .sqlite .duckdb file, .parquet file directory . Re-running store resumes: tables already profiled skipped. Use resume = FALSE start .
code: library(DBinventory) con <- "Driver={ODBC Driver 18 for SQL Server};Server=warehouse;Database=DW;Trusted_Connection=yes;TrustServerCertificate=yes;"  # Sampled report: tables above a million rows are profiled on a sample of their # rows. Best for a large warehouse, where reading every row of every table # would take too long for a first look. out <- inventory_run(con, organisation = "Example NHS Trust",                      store = "dw_inventory.sqlite", report = "dw_inventory.html")  # Full report: every row of every table. Best when the database is small enough # to read in full, or when exact distinct counts and uniqueness matter, as they # do when choosing keys. out <- inventory_run(con, organisation = "Example NHS Trust", sample_rows = Inf,                      store = "dw_inventory_full.sqlite", report = "dw_inventory_full.html")  out$inventory$tables   # one row per table or view out$profile            # one row per column # a directory of Parquet files, one schema per subdirectory out <- inventory_run("data/v2/sample", store = "sample_inventory.sqlite")  # the Fake NHS Trust synthetic dataset, for a first look (downloads the 130 MB sample once) out <- inventory_run(fakehospdata::fh_connect("sample"), store = "fakehosp_inventory.sqlite",                      organisation = "Fake NHS Trust")

title: DBinventory
code: con <- db_connect("Driver={ODBC Driver 18 for SQL Server};Server=...;Database=...;Trusted_Connection=yes;")  tables  <- db_tables(con, schema = "dbo", exclude = "\\.tmp_|_backup$") inv     <- db_inventory(con, schema = "dbo")           # tables + columns + counts + freshness + sizes prof    <- db_profile(con, inv, sample_rows = 1e6,     # sample tables above a million rows                       store = "dw_inventory.sqlite")   # checkpoint per table dups    <- duplicate_candidates(prof)                  # same data in more than one table? render_report("dw_inventory.sqlite", "dw_inventory.html")  DBI::dbDisconnect(con)

title: DBinventory
text: choices made brief left room; easy change. Values suppressed default. profile hospital warehouse committed repository, min_value, max_value top_values withheld columns inferred free text identifiers 200 distinct values, columns whose names suggest personal data (nhs, mrn, postcode, dob, name, address, …). Hashes fingerprints computed suppression, copies still match. Pass keep_values = TRUE output held securely. Large tables sampled default. Exact COUNT(*) MAX(datetime) always run full table; value statistics tables sample_rows (default million) computed sample materialised session temporary table (TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM SQL Server, USING SAMPLE ... (system) DuckDB, ORDER random() SQLite, TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM (pct) PostgreSQL; views SQL Server fall back first rows). sampled sample_method record happened. sample_rows = Inf gives full report. One query per table aggregates, one per eligible column top values. Aggregates batched column_batch columns time. Top values skipped columns top_values_max_distinct distinct values, frequency table says little. SELECT needed. Metadata comes INFORMATION_SCHEMA (sqlite_master SQLite). Table sizes come sys.dm_db_partition_stats SQL Server pg_total_relation_size PostgreSQL login can see , NA otherwise. Temporary tables need extra rights. Statistics type support skipped, failed. MIN() SQL Server bit, COUNT(DISTINCT) text, ntext, xml geography; timestamp SQL Server classified binary (row version). table fails reason logged profile_log run continues. store SQLite. single file, needs RSQLite, checkpoint. store_export() writes CSV (always) Parquet (arrow duckdb). report Quarto document inst/report/inventory_report.qmd, rendered Quarto CLI present otherwise rmarkdown::render(), handles knitr chunks.

title: DBinventory 0.1.0
text: First working version. Inventory: db_inventory() lists every table column exact row counts, sizes system views readable, newest datetime per table freshness signal. Column profile: db_profile() records null rate, distinct count, uniqueness, min, max, mean, string lengths top values per column, inferred semantic type, pk_candidate, two fingerprint hashes. Literal values suppressed free text, large identifier columns personal-data column names unless keep_values = TRUE. Foreign keys: infer_foreign_keys() proposes, column, key column looks like reference , confidence score evidence behind . Candidates , key register confirm. Dialects Microsoft SQL Server (main target), DuckDB, SQLite PostgreSQL; db_connect() takes connection string, DSN, SQLite DuckDB file, Parquet files directories; parquet_connect() exposes Parquet directory DuckDB database. SQLite results store per-table checkpointing resume, CSV Parquet export, inventory_run() everything one call. Quarto report (render_report()) ggplot2 plots, candidate duplicate columns, foreign key candidates searchable column profile; title takes organisation prefix. Developed Fake NHS Trust synthetic dataset fakehospdata package; tests run offline small fixture.
